# HEIC fixtures (feat/image-heic)

Encoded by Apple's own HEIC encoder (macOS `sips -s format heic`, ImageIO), on
2026-11-26, from the CC0 JPEG fixtures next door (`../jpeg/`, see its README for the
source photo and licence: CC0). Not made by tentacle's code. Each is 64×48 stored, grid-free,
`ftyp` brand `heic`; the orientation of the source JPEG is carried as an `irot` box + EXIF.
